Subject: Close-ready deals: confirm amounts & SKUs

Quick ask — running a two-day sweep on all close-ready/opportunity-stage deals to make sure our forecast is accurate heading into month close. Please update the CRM fields below for any deals you own or are supporting by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-09):

- Amount: round to the committed ARR/one-time amount we will invoice (no provisional discounts).
- Product / SKU: pick the SKU that will be invoiced (if multiple SKUs, list primary + secondary).
- Next step: explicit action (e.g., "Send PO + DocuSign", "Legal review - signature expected", "Billing input needed").
- Probability: set to the commit probability that finance should use for this close (if you are asking for a change, add a one-line justification).

I've attached a compact matrix (acme-deal-matrix-ACME-2026-48.xlsx) with the deals I believe are close. I'm tagging the known owners in the sheet — please correct inline. Sarah, copying you so procurement timing is visible.

If anything needs an exec nudge or credit discussion, flag in reply and I'll escalate to revenue ops.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
